start.title: A Joyful Feast
start.text:
Lanterns sway. Laughter rises.
The bride and groom dance.

slip_consequence.title: Return
slip_consequence.text:
The feast still calls you.
Go back.

shortage.title: The Last Cup
shortage.text:
Whispers spread: the wine is gone.
Mary's eyes find her son.

pretend_consequence.title: Speak
pretend_consequence.text:
The guests will notice.
Do not pretend.

mother.title: His Mother's Voice
mother.text:
"They have no more wine," she says.
Then turns to you.

wait_consequence.title: Trust Her Words
wait_consequence.text:
She has already spoken.
Obey her son.

instruct.title: A Quiet Command
instruct.text:
Jesus points to six stone jars.
"Fill them with water."

choices.text: Ask why — it is only water
Fill every jar to the brim

ask_consequence.title: Just Do It
ask_consequence.text:
Questions can wait.
Lift the water.

choices.text: Fill every jar to the brim

half_consequence.title: All of Them
half_consequence.text:
He said every jar.
Do not hold back.

choices.text: Fill every jar to the brim

fill.title: To the Brim
fill.text:
Six jars, full of cool water.
"Now draw some out," he says.

taste.title: The First Sip
taste.text:
The steward's eyes widen.
"You saved the best for last!"

boast_consequence.title: Be Still
boast_consequence.text:
The wonder is his alone.
Give thanks.

slip2_consequence.title: Witness It
slip2_consequence.text:
Stay. See what he has done.
Give thanks.

wonder.title: The First Sign
wonder.text:
The disciples look at Jesus.
They believe.
